spans.s: Saumadatti^1 (“the son of Somadatta”) = Bhūriśravas: I, 536 (C. by error Soº); II, 1713; III, 15084; V, †791, †887, 4171 (Bhº), 5530 (ºtimiṅgilaṃ, sc. purushodadhiṃ, i.e. the army of Duryodhana), 5573 (do.), 5742 (Bhº); VI, 837, 1653, 1705, 2092, 2108 (only B., C. has Somadattaḥ), †2672, 2688, †2811 (Bhº), 2815, 3261, 3298, 3730, 3731, 3934, 4244, 4407, 5052, 5103, 5184 (Bhº), 5187, 5188; VII, 537 (º-Śikhaṇḍinau), 539, 1116, 1117, 1650, 3027, 3098, 3540 (ºpurogamāḥ), 3921, 3947 (ºeḥ punar yūpo yajñaśīlasya dhīmataḥ / dhvajaḥ sūrya ivābhāti somaś cātra pradṛśyate), 3948, 4329, 5900, 5901, 5908, 5931, 5942, 6001, 6043, 6328, 6337 (only B.), 6526 (hataḥ), 6783 (ºvadhāt), 8307 (ºer vadhāt), 9158 (hataḥ); VIII, 3646; XI, 686 (Yūpaketoḥ).
Saumadatti^2 (do.) = Śala(?): VII, 3979, 4053, 4055, 4056, 4060, 4064 (fought against the Draupadeyas and was slain by the son of Sahadeva).
Saumaki^1 (“king of the Somakas” or “descendant of Somaka”) = Drupada: I, 5192, †7198 (rājā), †7345; II, 126 (Yajñasenaḥ), †2523 (do.).

*Saumya, adj. (“belonging to Soma (the Moon)”). § 305 (Dyūtap.): II, 78, 2578 (ātmapradānaṃ saumyaṃ tvaṃ, B. saumyatvaṃ).--§ 440 (Yakshayuddhap.): III, 164, 11900 (sc. astraṃ).--§ 512 (Ghoshayātrāp.): III, 245, 14995 (do.). --§ 588 (Bhīshmavadhap.): VI, 121, 5801 (do.).--§ 603b (Nārāyaṇa): VII, 201, 9466 (karma).--§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 46, 2654 (sc. mātaraḥ).--§ 616 (Sauptikap.): X, 7, 304 (mantreṇa).--§ 746 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 76, †3675 (gāvaḥ).
